written_before: any cycle-3 diagnostic score on fresh tests 1, 2 or 3 (h2n on tests 2 and 3, zero-shot rubric-prompted base models on tests 1-3)

practice_sets.rule: Fresh tests 1, 2 and 3 are practice sets for cycle 3: they may be used for diagnosis and for selecting the cycle-3 pick. Their recorded results (eval/fresh_test_result_v4.json, eval/fresh_test2_result.json, eval/fresh_test3_result.json) stand as written and are never rescored or overwritten.
practice_sets.never_trained_on: No row, posting or employer from fresh tests 1, 2 or 3 enters any training file.

judge.rule: The cycle-3 pick is judged once on a new sealed fresh test 4, built from postings the freeze reserved and no pool or test used, sealed and labeled by two blind labelers before any cycle-3 model is scored on it, under amendment 2's pass bar (beat both full rules and the untrained model + eligibility layer on eligibility-pass macro-F1, two-way bootstrap lower bound above 0). Test 4 is built to hold at least 40 gold Keeps on its eligibility-pass slice so the bar has power.

diagnostics.outputs: data/models/diag_cycle3/ and eval/diag_cycle3*.json, never the write-once fresh*_result paths
